content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the function returning an error code (-EIO) when it could not find the best clock sample value among the candidates, even though there were candidate values available. This behavior was inappropriate as it prevented the system from functioning correctly with the eMMC. The patch modifies the logic to use the first candidate value if the best value is not found, allowing the system to continue operating instead of failing.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by the function returning an error code (-EIO) when it could not find the best clock sample value among the candidates, even though there were candidate values available. This behavior was inappropriate as it prevented the system from functioning correctly with the eMMC. The patch modifies the logic to use the first candidate value if the best value is not found, allowing the system to continue operating instead of failing.
Patch:
From 697542bceae51f7620af333b065dd09d213629fb Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Jaehoon Chung <jh80.chung@samsung.com>
Date: Fri, 22 Oct 2021 17:21:06 +0900
Subject: [PATCH] mmc: dw_mmc: exynos: fix the finding clock sample value

Even though there are candiates value if can't find best value, it's
returned -EIO. It's not proper behavior.
If there is not best value, use a first candiate value to work eMMC.

Signed-off-by: Jaehoon Chung <jh80.chung@samsung.com>
Tested-by: Marek Szyprowski <m.szyprowski@samsung.com>
Tested-by: Christian Hewitt <christianshewitt@gmail.com>
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Fixes: c537a1c5ff63 ("mmc: dw_mmc: exynos: add variable delay tuning sequence")
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20211022082106.1557-1-jh80.chung@samsung.com
Signed-off-by: Ulf Hansson <ulf.hansson@linaro.org>
---
 drivers/mmc/host/dw_mmc-exynos.c | 14 ++++++++++++++
 1 file changed, 14 insertions(+)

diff --git a/drivers/mmc/host/dw_mmc-exynos.c b/drivers/mmc/host/dw_mmc-exynos.c
index 0c75810812a0..1f8a3c0ddfe1 100644
--- a/drivers/mmc/host/dw_mmc-exynos.c
+++ b/drivers/mmc/host/dw_mmc-exynos.c
@@ -464,6 +464,18 @@ static s8 dw_mci_exynos_get_best_clksmpl(u8 candiates)
 		}
 	}
 
+	/*
+	 * If there is no cadiates value, then it needs to return -EIO.
+	 * If there are candiates values and don't find bset clk sample value,
+	 * then use a first candiates clock sample value.
+	 */
+	for (i = 0; i < iter; i++) {
+		__c = ror8(candiates, i);
+		if ((__c & 0x1) == 0x1) {
+			loc = i;
+			goto out;
+		}
+	}
 out:
 	return loc;
 }
@@ -494,6 +506,8 @@ static int dw_mci_exynos_execute_tuning(struct dw_mci_slot *slot, u32 opcode)
 		priv->tuned_sample = found;
 	} else {
 		ret = -EIO;
+		dev_warn(&mmc->class_dev,
+			"There is no candiates value about clksmpl!\n");
 	}
 
 	return ret;
--
